name: cbx-playwright
description: Automated UI testing for CBX Cloud (TradeBeyond) OI UAT using Playwright + TypeScript

scripts.regression:fresh: rm -f fixtures/.auth/user.json && npx playwright test tests/auth.setup.ts --headed && npx playwright test tests/e2e/regression-orchestrator.spec.ts --headed --workers=1 --retries=1
scripts.cbx-dev:setup: npm run env:cbx-dev && npx playwright test --project=setup
scripts.cbx-dev:test: npm run env:cbx-dev && npx playwright test tests/e2e/cbx-dev/
scripts.cbx-dev:test:headed: npm run env:cbx-dev && npx playwright test tests/e2e/cbx-dev/ --headed
scripts.cbx-uat:setup: npm run env:cbx-uat && npx playwright test --project=setup
scripts.cbx-uat:test: npm run env:cbx-uat && npx playwright test tests/e2e/cbx-dev/
scripts.cbx-uat:test:headed: npm run env:cbx-uat && npx playwright test tests/e2e/cbx-dev/ --headed
scripts.oi-uat:setup: npm run env:oi-uat && npx playwright test --project=setup
scripts.oi-uat:test: npm run env:oi-uat && npx playwright test tests/e2e/oi/
scripts.oi-uat:test:headed: npm run env:oi-uat && npx playwright test tests/e2e/oi/ --headed
